answer: In our EigenTrust topology, Sybil resistance relies on exponential score decay where accumulated validity melts like a glacier without active proof. A malicious cluster forms an isolated oasis of fake endorsements, but lacking inbound transitivity from the elevated mesa of established peers, freshly spawned Sybils maintain near-zero eigenvector centrality. Because consensus requires sustained honest interactions to cross dynamic thresholds, unweighted ephemeral clones are deterministically pruned.
